title: GWAS Catalog associations
description: Published genome-wide associations between variants and traits. Population-level associations, not statements about any individual. Lifted from GRCh38 to GRCh37 at build time.

source.name: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog, all associations with ontology annotations

citation: Cerezo M. et al. The NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog: standards for reusability, sustainability and diversity. Nucleic Acids Res. 2025;53:D998–D1005
